title: Normality of the fixing subgroup characterizes Galois intermediate fields
statement: Let $K\subseteq M$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is Galois, meaning separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal (the minimal polynomial over $K$ of every element of $M$ splits into linear factors over $M$). Let $E$ be any intermediate field, $K\subseteq E\subseteq M$, and put $H=\{g\in\operatorname{Aut}_K(M):g(e)=e\text{ for all }e\in E\}$. Then $H$ is a normal subgroup of $\operatorname{Aut}_K(M)$ if and only if $E/K$ is Galois. No finiteness assumption is imposed on either field extension.
